title: 2005 AMC 10B Problem 5
statement: Brianna is using part of the money she earned on her weekend job to buy several equally-priced CDs. She used one fifth of her money to buy one third of the CDs. What fraction of her money will she have left after she buys all the CDs?

solutions.text:
Buying all the CDs costs three times as much as buying one third of them, namely \(3 \cdot \dfrac15 = \dfrac35\) of her money.

The fraction left over is \(1 - \dfrac35 = \dfrac25.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Buying all the CDs costs three times as much as buying one third of them
All the CDs cost \(3\cdot\dfrac15\) of her money
